facts.season: "The best time of year for surfing Jungmun Beach (Jeju Island) with consistent clean waves (rideable swell with light / offshore winds) is during Summer and most often the month of June." (surf-forecast)
accessNotes: access "Jeju Island (South Korea) is one-hour flight from Seoul. Jeju is a volcanic island that has kept traditional Korean cultural identity in houses and lifestyle. Most beaches are made of black lava stones; some are sand covered. Jeju is renown for Stones, Winds and Women. Lava stones are pilled on the ocean-side roads as wishing-good-luck monuments. Winds are often strong and can change directions many times during the day. Women are diving to catch seafood / shellfish and selling them on the roadsides. You can see them getting out of a small creek with in wetsuit and goggles!"; distance: Take a car; public access: Public access (wannasurf)

guideSummary.surfnerd: Jungmun Beach is the most popular surf spot on Jeju and holds the island's best concentration of breaks, set against a dramatic backdrop of towering black basalt cliffs. It has been named among Asia's Top 10 Beaches and shows up often as a filming location. The beach has two main peaks.
guideSummary.surfForecast: Jungmun Beach (Jeju Island) in South Korea is an exposed beach and reef break. Summer offers the favoured conditions for surfing. Works best in offshore winds from the north. The ideal swell direction from the south southwest. The beach breaks offer lefts and rights and in addition there are both left and right reef breaks. Unlikely to be too crowded, even when the surf is up. Watch out for - Rips / undertow - Rocks.
